motion.name: control-feedback
motion.purpose: Colour/background and active-underline opacity feedback; reduced motion disables both, touch-only devices omit colour/background transitions.

components.name: Identity portrait
components.description: User-supplied full-square portrait above the name: 80px desktop, 64px mobile, 4px corners, no badge, shadow or new interaction. Adjacent name supplies identity; empty alt avoids repetition.
components.css: .ds-portrait { display: block; width: 80px; height: 80px; flex: 0 0 auto; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--surface, #ebebeb); } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-portrait { width: 64px; height: 64px; margin-bottom: 8px; } }

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Square action: slate/white in light, warm sand/charcoal in dark, and accessible orange hover in both.
components.css: .ds-button { font: 12px ui-monospace, monospace; border: 0; border-radius: 0; padding: 12px 20px; min-height: 44px; background: var(--button, #4b5563); color: var(--button-ink, #fff); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-button:hover, .ds-button:focus-visible { background: var(--orange, #fb923c); color: var(--orange-ink, #211f1c); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #b94708); outline-offset: 5px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button { transition: none; } }

components.name: Text link
components.description: Underlined on hover, with a visible focus outline.
components.css: .ds-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; font: 12px ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--ink, #242424); text-decoration: none; text-underline-offset: 5px; } .ds-link:hover { color: var(--accent, #b94708); text-decoration: underline; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #b94708); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Language selector
components.description: Native select with a compact visual footprint and 44px target.
components.css: .ds-language { font: 12px ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--ink, #242424); background: transparent; border: 0; min-width: 52px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 4px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-language:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #b94708); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Cardless view selection
components.description: Separate GUI and Dev Mode native buttons explicitly select a view. Complementary pressed states, thin active underline, 12px mono labels and 44px minimum targets; no slider geometry.
components.css: .ds-views { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-view { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 4px; background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 0; color: var(--muted, #656461); font: 12px ui-monospace, monospace; cursor: pointer; } .ds-view::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 4px; right: 4px; bottom: 7px; height: 1px; background: currentColor; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 150ms ease; } .ds-view[aria-pressed='true'] { color: var(--ink, #242424); } .ds-view[aria-pressed='true']::after { opacity: 1; } .ds-view:hover { color: var(--accent, #b94708); } .ds-view:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #b94708); outline-offset: 5px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-view::after { transition: none; } }

components.name: Single theme icon
components.description: One current-state sun/moon icon; pressed means dark, accessible name stays stable and tooltip names the next theme. Shared by portfolio and readers; focused theme updates do not rewrite language content. 44px target, manipulation touch handling and accent focus.
components.html: <button class="ds-theme" type="button" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Colour theme: Dark" title="Colour theme: Dark"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4"/><path d="M12 2v3m0 14v3M2 12h3m14 0h3M5 5l2 2m10 10 2 2M5 19l2-2M17 7l2-2" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-theme { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; padding: 0; background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 0; color: var(--muted, #656461); cursor: pointer; } .ds-theme[aria-pressed='true'] { color: var(--button, #d8c8b4); } .ds-theme:hover { color: var(--accent, #b94708); } .ds-theme:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #b94708); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Portfolio command input
components.description: Native text editing inside the finite command view, not a shell. Accent caret/focus, 44px target, shared page plane.
components.html: <label class="ds-command-label" for="ds-command">Portfolio command</label><input class="ds-command" id="ds-command" type="text" maxlength="256" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false">
components.css: .ds-command-label { display: block; font: 12px ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--surface-accent, #af4207); } .ds-command { min-height: 44px; min-width: 0; font: 15px ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--ink, #242424); background: var(--page, #f4f4f5); border: 0; border-radius: 0; padding: 8px; caret-color: var(--accent, #b94708); } .ds-command:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #b94708); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Development status
components.description: Plain metadata, not a pill or an unavailable fake link.

components.name: Gallery navigation
components.description: 44px authored-chevron control with manipulation touch handling. A pending image selection retains the decoded photograph and stable field with localized status; only adjacent photos are prepared in a bounded cache, unless Save Data or a known slow connection is active.
components.html: <button class="ds-gallery-nav" aria-label="Next image"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" height="16" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 3 5 5-5 5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.2"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-gallery-nav { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #242424); border: 0; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-gallery-nav:hover { background: var(--surface, #ebebeb); } .ds-gallery-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #b94708); outline-offset: 5px; }

narrative.overview: This document applies to the default Quiet portfolio at /, its /templates/quiet/ alias and its readers. The preserved /templates/ocean/ edition keeps its own visual system. The approved synthesis uses Ellipsis's label/content composition, Conductor-informed neutral planes, and Readman's wide photographic framing.
keyCharacteristics: Thin rules instead of enclosing project cards.
Compact mono typography and generous intervals.
Real photography as the primary visual material.
Native scrolling with hidden scrollbars and immediately visible content.

rules.name: The Contrast Rule
rules.body: Keep button foreground and fill paired. White on the orange hover fill does not meet the normal-text contrast target. Text on the lighter command surface uses its darker orange tone: the normal page accent measured 4.44:1 there; the surface accent measures 4.89:1. Dark command text keeps the existing orange.

dos: Do preserve the label/content alignment and readable mobile reflow.
Do keep publication types, development status, and uncertainty visible.
Do use the user's photographs with recorded provenance.
Do keep the static English snapshot synchronized with the renderer.
donts: Don't import this stylesheet into the original ocean entry.
Don't add card shells, shadows, page loaders, or decorative animation to this template without a new brief.
Don't put white text on the orange button state.
Don't turn a research proposal into a claim of demonstrated performance.
